{{Quote|I sense something very dark and very powerful ahead.|X2, sensing the Nightsister Matriarch's presence inside X1's base|<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />}}
The "'''Nightsister Matriarch'''" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Witches of Dathomir|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and active during the administration of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Matriarch led a group of Nightsisters in an [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on the planetary [[X1's Dathomir base|base]] that belonged to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[X1]]. Soon enough, the New Republic's [[Grey Squadron]] joined the fight. During the battle, the Matriarch confronted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by him.

==Biography==
[[File:Matriarch_Rancor.jpg|thumb|left|The Nightsister Matriarch riding a rancor]]
The "Nightsister Matriarch" was a title held by a pale-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] sect who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the sovereignty of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[X1]] established a [[X1's Dathomir base|facility]] on the planet, where he conducted experiments with [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]]. X1 eventually fled the planet, and the Nightsisters, led by the Matriarch, [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|overran]] the facility. While the Nightsisters fought X1's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] outside the base, the Matriarch, riding a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], infiltrated the facility itself.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />

At some point between [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] and [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the New Republic's [[Grey Squadron]], led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]], arrived on the planet in search of X1. Fighting through the Nightsisters, [[Color/Legends|Grey]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] reached the entrance to the base. [[Force sense/Legends|Sensing]] the Matriarch's presence, X2 left his men at the entrance to provide backup and went inside alone. Breaking through a wall, the Matriarch attacked X2, but he was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the rancor. She subsequently charged X2 with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight prevailed and killed her as well.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Nightsister Matriarch was a skilled practitioner of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and her dark presence was strong enough to be sensed by X2. She utilized a red-bladed lightsaber in battle and was adept at [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. The Matriarch was also [[Animal bond|able to control]] her rancor and used it in the fight against X2.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightsister Matriarch appears as a boss in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />
